Elena / team —

Quick update and config snippet below. We added tenant_id to the sample (re-uploaded audit-logs-sample.json to Drive).

S3 export (private deployment) — minimal example (high level):
1) Enable audit-log-export in /etc/redwood/config.yaml: 
   audit_log_export:
     enabled: true
     destination: s3://fastpay-redwood-logs
     format: json
     include_fields: [request_id, model_identifier, tenant_id, user_id, timestamp]
2) IAM role: redwood-audit-export-role with PutObject and ListBucket to the target bucket.
3) Rotation & retention: lifecycle rule on bucket set to 90 days unless policy overrides.

Pen-test notes: Karthik has the vendor shortlist and will share the proposed testing window (suggested: 2027-01-10 to 2027-01-24).

I will bundle the config snippet and the updated sample into MAP-evidence-bundle.zip and place it in the Drive link.
